recorded.what: SL-14 HOLDOUT 5 - INVENTED, and frozen on 2026-09-16 BEFORE it was run even once, and BEFORE the implementation change that holdout 4's reading calls for. Ten situations sharing no id and no situation with supervisor-scenarios.json or with any of the four earlier holdouts.
recorded.whyAFIFTHHoldout: Holdout 4 was frozen unrun, measured, and FAILED: every zero bar held in all ten runs, but the ordinary failure-rate bar was breached in 4 of 10 runs, and because every situation in that set is SL-14-owned, all four gated closure. Reading that result diagnosed three distinct causes, and a repair follows. The rule that produced holdout 4 applies to holdout 4 in turn: once an independent holdout has been read diagnostically, a fresh one is frozen BEFORE the implementation change, or the next measurement would be of a change tuned against the instrument meant to judge it. Holdout 4 is kept unedited with its result.
recorded.whyEVERYSituationHereIsSL14OWNED: The same property that made holdout 4 answer the question, kept deliberately. Every scenario carries an SL-14 acceptance expectation - a blocked alias with a disposition owed, or the boundary assertion that nothing here may be offered recovery. `isSl14Owned` is true for all ten, so the closure rule's exception is structurally unavailable and every breach here gates closure. A byte-identity audit of this set can buy it nothing.
recorded.whatWasKNOWNWhenThisWasAUTHORED: Everything holdout 4 measured, in full, including the three causes of its twenty failures in one hundred calls: ten judgments DISCARDED because the model wrote the recovery wire action `leave_blocked` into `posture`, proven mechanically once the discard reason was carried into the evidence; seven judgments that dispositioned every alias coherently, and said in prose that no internal capability remained, yet left the structured `capability_gap` null; and three postures outside the situation's range, `no_op` where a technical failure left a need standing. Not known: any behavior of the repaired implementation on any of the ten situations below, none of which existed before this file. The repair that follows this freeze was DESIGNED but not written when this set was authored, and the two causes it targets are deliberately EXERCISED here rather than authored around - `h5-blocked-valuation-capability-withdrawn` and `h5-three-blocked-items-one-capability-gone` both assert the capability gap, and eight of the ten situations carry blocked Work, which is where the discard concentrates. Authoring away from a known failure is the one thing that would make this set worthless.
recorded.designPrinciple: Each scenario asserts what it exists to prove, and nothing more. Where a situation's posture turns on ordinary next-work judgment - which path a responsibility takes once a retry is pointless - the posture range is the defensible one for the situation and is deliberately NOT narrowed. Narrowing it would score SL-4's ordinary judgment as an SL-14 failure.
recorded.coverage: The recovery situations the earlier holdouts cover, in situations that share nothing with them: a first transient failure with the need standing, a spent Supervisor retry meeting the same error, a capability withdrawn from the available list, a result nobody needs any more, a replan onto an available equivalent, several blocked items owed different dispositions at once, a blocked item beside an answered question, a blocked item where prospect contact IS available, and both boundary assertions - a human wait and a technically successful but unwelcome result.
recorded.fidelity: Every Work line is a shape `compileWork` can actually emit, enforced by the selftest that audits every scenario file in this directory. Where a blocked item has already spent its one Supervisor retry, the set declares `retryExhaustedAliases`, exactly as the compile does.
recorded.gap: Wholly synthetic, like every other set here. No production lead, message, contact or property is reproduced. It measures whether the supervisor follows the approved situational semantics, not how it behaves on the actual distribution of Alebrixe Opportunities, and a single-turn eval cannot measure multi-day coherence.
recorded.bars: The same five bars as the main set, at the same ratified values. Nothing here moves one.
recorded.howThisSetMayBeUSED: Once. If its result is read and an implementation change follows, this set is observed too, and a further independent holdout must be frozen before that change.

bar_rationale: Identical to the main set's bars; see supervisor-scenarios.json.
